title: Cybersecurity incident affects EURR token operations

security_incident_detail.summary: Unauthorized external access affected token operations and led StablR to suspend minting and redemption. The initial disclosure stated that circulating EURR and USDR supply was not fully backed at the required 1:1 ratio after the incident.
security_incident_detail.loss_or_exposure_text: Exact unauthorized issuance amount, resulting supply imbalance, and terminal recovery outcome remain unresolved in the reviewed official sources.

title: StablR activates Recovery Plan for EURR

redemption_change_detail.summary: Minting and redemption remained suspended under the Recovery Plan while forensic, operational, legal, regulatory, and stakeholder review continued.

title: StablR activates Recovery Plan for USDR

redemption_change_detail.summary: Minting and redemption remained suspended under the Recovery Plan while forensic, operational, legal, regulatory, and stakeholder review continued.

title: StablR reports EURR incident containment while suspension continues

security_incident_detail.summary: StablR reported containment of the immediate incident, secured affected minting controls, and no further unauthorized issuance since 24 May; minting and redemption remained suspended.
security_incident_detail.loss_or_exposure_text: Terminal recovery, backing-restoration metrics, and service-reactivation timing remain unresolved.
